free_per_month.quote: Your first 25 reconciled statements each month are free.

setup.quote: Statement Zen writes the query, and you paste it into Vista’s Workflow Notifier once.

setup_time.quote: About ten minutes for your IT team, once.

read_only.quote: Statement Zen does not log in, never reads your database directly, and cannot change data in your system.

forward.quote: Forward it to your unique Statement Zen address in the format you received it

closing_balance.quote: reports the closing balance as proven or not.
